      The ribs

      Smoked spare ribs. Get 2–3 with a side, 4–5 with two sides, or a whole rack of 10–12.

      Bobby's Brisket

      Smoked beef brisket on a bun or as a plate. The most talked-about thing in the reviews.

      The sides

      Baked beans, green beans, potato salad, cole slaw. Mac n cheese is the premium one.
